caption: The highlighted cells show X (23) plus 3 wrapping to A (0); the bottom row confirms subtracting 3 restores EXAM.

spec.title: Caesar cipher on EXAM with k = 3
spec.aria: An array showing the Caesar cipher on EXAM with shift 3: plaintext letters E, X, A, M have numbers 4, 23, 0, 12; adding 3 modulo 26 gives 7, 0, 3, 15, which are H, A, D, P; subtracting 3 restores 4, 23, 0, 12 and the plaintext EXAM.
